name: An Evening Of Events
source: On a warm summer day, young Emily invites a few friends to join her for a vacation at her home, where she lives with her single father. What they don’t know is that Emily’s friend Jessica has far more than just a harmless evening planned…​
translation: 在一个温暖的夏日，年轻的艾米丽邀请几个朋友到她和单亲父亲住在一起的家里度假。他们不知道的是，艾米丽的朋友杰西卡计划的不仅仅是一个无害的夜晚……​
